title: 2021 Copyright
description: If you find yourself in Ireland with a 2021 copyright, you'll likely be in the very north of the country.

title: 2021 coverage in the north
description: In Ireland, apart from a few reprocessed panoramas, 2021 coverage is always in the northern third of the island, including Northern Ireland. The Google car has since revisited this area in 2024 and 2025.
